message:
fix(apk): no X edge, no X bit to a host without kCaptureFlagMouseXButtonsV1 -- JNI, macro, park, queued (keepalive-r2 e)

The shared session the Android app drives had no X capability fence: nativeQueueInputEvent masked
buttons to 0x7 but passed keyCode 5/6, and macro playback passed both (codex_ka_pc_src_r7.md, APK
impact). The PC viewer's contract (fence_mouse_for_host) now holds in ClientSessionController too:
QueueInputEvent refuses an X edge and masks the X bits for a host without the flag (or not known
yet), and the control loop applies the same fence right before sending whatever reached the queue
another way (park / held releases, DropAllButReleases). A host with the flag is unchanged.

Test: client_session_xbutton_fence_test, the product session against a fake control host --
direct/macro/park, old host vs X host, plus the action fence: 23/23 x6. Mutants: queue-time fence
removed -> 4 FAIL, wire X still 0 (the send-time fence caught them); both removed -> 6 FAIL, X edges
on the wire. role_park 13/13, prelogin_select 60/60. Shared core untouched.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
